What we offer

Our services

From individual custom orders to large institutional supply — everything made to your exact specification.

Manufacturing

What we make

🧥

Sweater Manufacturing

Full end-to-end manufacturing of sweaters and knitwear. We source premium, durable yarn and apply tight quality control at every stage — from knitting to finishing.

🎨

Custom Embroidery

Digital and hand embroidery for logos, monograms, names, and custom designs. Sharp detail and colour-fastness guaranteed across hundreds of garments.

🏷️

Badge Printing & Application

In-house badge printing with professional heat and stitch application. Suitable for school crests, security insignia, and corporate branding.

👔

Corporate Uniforms

Bulk uniform programs for businesses — consistent sizing, on-brand colours, and volume discounts. We work with your branding team directly.

🎓

School Uniforms

Institutional sweater programs with standardised sizing charts, school colour matching, and large-volume capability. Trusted by schools across Uganda.

🛡️

Security Uniforms

Robust, professional-grade security wear with badge placement, epaulettes, and rank markings. Built for daily outdoor use.

👤

Personal Orders

No minimum order for individual pieces. Pick your colour, material, and personalisation — we'll craft it to your specification.

📦

Bulk & Wholesale

Volume pricing available from 50 units. Long-term supply agreements welcome for schools, NGOs, and resellers.

How it works

Our process

Simple, transparent, and designed around your timeline.

1

Tell us what you need

Send us your specs via WhatsApp, email, or the contact form — quantity, design, colours, and deadline.

2

We send a quote

Receive an itemised quote within 24 hours. No hidden costs — what you see is what you pay.

3

Approve & produce

Once you approve the design and quote, we begin production. Turnaround depends on quantity and complexity.

4

Deliver or collect

Collect from our Gayaza or Kampala location, or arrange delivery anywhere in Uganda.
